aboutText: NhaiKanji combines Japanese dictation, shadowing, flashcards and short practice activities. This version uses original sample content and saves progress in your browser.
privacyText: Progress, decks, notes and demo profiles are saved in this browser’s localStorage. Recordings are created on your device only after microphone permission; recordings are not automatically uploaded. Clearing site data deletes the demo data. Google/email sign-in requires a configured server.
termsText: Sample lessons and exams are for practice and are not official JLPT exams. Recording supports self-review rather than proficiency certification. Do not enter sensitive information into shared demo data.
contactText: You can write suggestions on the Feedback page. In this demo, feedback stays in your browser and is not automatically sent to any third party.
